response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack software engineer (15+ years) with strong web, backend, and testing credentials, but the role requires deep hardware-oriented expertise — SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator architecture, GPU/SIMD-MIMD workload analysis, and hardware-software co-design — none of which appear in the resume. The closest adjacent experience is some C/C++ work at National Instruments, embedded/robotics integration at Altom, and low-latency service optimization in DLang at Sociomantic, which demonstrates performance sensitivity but at the application layer, not silicon. Education is a BS in Computer Science (meets the 8+ years path formally) but without the architecture/DNN specialization the role centers on. This is a fundamental domain mismatch rather than a seniority gap.
strengths: 15+ years of engineering experience with staff/senior-level scope
Low-latency, high-throughput systems work in C/C++ and DLang
Strong engineering rigor: TDD, CI/CD, open-source tooling authorship
concerns: No SoC, IP modeling, or hardware architecture experience
No deep-learning training/inference or GPU/accelerator workload background
Skill set is web/full-stack oriented, not hardware-software co-design

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP modeling and accelerator architecture experience
Extensive senior software engineering and systems performance experience
